close_reason: Spaces fully implemented: 9 sub-beads closed. 11 tables, 40+ store methods, 12 JMAP handlers, 5-step permission engine. All tests pass.
description: kith has zero Space-layer implementation. Missing types: Space, Channel, SpaceRole, SpaceMember, ChannelPermission, SpaceInvite, SpaceBan. Missing permission vocabulary: view, send, pin, manage_channels, manage_members, manage_roles, manage_space, ban, mention_broadcast, start_call. This is the largest spec gap — kith only supports direct and group chats. Spec reference: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md sections 4.20+, 5.7-5.13.
design:
## Plan: Implement Spaces (Space, Channel, Roles, Permissions)

This is the largest issue. The plan is phased to allow incremental delivery.

### Phase 1: Core types and storage (minimum viable Space)

**1a. kith-core: Define Space-layer types**
- New file: kith-core/src/space.rs
  - `SpaceRole { id, name, color: Option<String>, permissions: Vec<String>, position: u64 }`
  - `SpaceMember { id, role_ids: Vec<String>, nick: Option<String>, joined_at: String }`
  - `Category { id, name, position: u64, channel_ids: Vec<String> }`
  - `Space { id, name, description: Option<String>, icon_blob_id: Option<String>, roles: Vec<SpaceRole>, members: Vec<SpaceMember>, categories: Vec<Category>, uncategorized_channel_ids: Vec<String>, created_at: String, is_public: bool, is_publicly_previewable: bool, member_count: u64 }`
- New file: kith-core/src/space_invite.rs
  - `SpaceInvite { id, code, space_id, default_channel_id: Option<String>, created_by, expires_at: Option<String>, max_uses: Option<u64>, uses: u64, created_at }`
- New file: kith-core/src/space_ban.rs
  - `SpaceBan { id, space_id, user_id, banned_by, reason: Option<String>, created_at, expires_at: Option<String> }`
- New file: kith-core/src/channel_permission.rs
  - `ChannelPermission { target_id, target_type: "role"|"member", allow: Vec<String>, deny: Vec<String> }`
- Update kith-core/src/chat.rs: add `kind: "channel"` variant, add `space_id: Option<String>` field

**1b. kith-store: Schema for Space tables**
- 7+ new tables via migration:
  - `spaces (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, icon_blob_id TEXT, created_at INTEGER, is_public INTEGER DEFAULT 0, is_publicly_previewable INTEGER DEFAULT 0, changed_at_counter INTEGER, created_at_counter INTEGER)`
  - `space_roles (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, space_id TEXT REFERENCES spaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, name TEXT, color TEXT, position INTEGER, changed_at_counter INTEGER)`
  - `space_role_permissions (role_id TEXT REFERENCES space_roles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, permission TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (role_id, permission))`
  - `space_members (space_id TEXT REFERENCES spaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, user_id TEXT, nick TEXT, joined_at INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (space_id, user_id))`
  - `space_member_roles (space_id TEXT, user_id TEXT, role_id TEXT REFERENCES space_roles(id), PRIMARY KEY (space_id, user_id, role_id), FOREIGN KEY (space_id, user_id) REFERENCES space_members(space_id, user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE)`
  - `categories (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, space_id TEXT REFERENCES spaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, name TEXT, position INTEGER)`
  - `category_channels (category_id TEXT REFERENCES categories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, chat_id TEXT REFERENCES chats(id), position INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (category_id, chat_id))`
  - `channel_permissions (chat_id TEXT REFERENCES chats(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, target_id TEXT, target_type TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (chat_id, target_id))`
  - `channel_permission_entries (chat_id TEXT, target_id TEXT, permission TEXT, effect TEXT CHECK(effect IN ('allow','deny')), PRIMARY KEY (chat_id, target_id, permission), FOREIGN KEY (chat_id, target_id) REFERENCES channel_permissions(chat_id, target_id) ON DELETE CASCADE)`
  - `space_invites (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, code TEXT UNIQUE, space_id TEXT REFERENCES spaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, default_channel_id TEXT, created_by TEXT, expires_at INTEGER, max_uses INTEGER, uses INTEGER DEFAULT 0, created_at INTEGER)`
  - `space_bans (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, space_id TEXT REFERENCES spaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, user_id TEXT, banned_by TEXT, reason TEXT, created_at INTEGER, expires_at INTEGER)`
- Add `space_id TEXT` column to `chats` table (nullable, only set for kind='channel')
- New state_counters entries: space, space_invite, space_ban
- New store modules: space.rs, space_invite.rs, space_ban.rs with CRUD operations

### Phase 2: JMAP method handlers

**2a. Space/get, Space/changes**
- File: new kith-jmap handler or kith-chat/src/space.rs
- Standard JMAP /get: load Space with all sub-arrays (roles, members, categories)
- Non-member visibility: if isPubliclyPreviewable, return restricted view; else notFound
- Space/changes: return changed space IDs since state

**2b. Space/set**
- Semantic mutation model (NOT PatchObject):
  - `name`, `description`, `iconBlobId` → require manage_space
  - `addRoles/removeRoles/updateRoles` → require manage_roles, enforce position hierarchy
  - `addMembers/removeMembers/updateMembers` → require manage_members
  - `addChannels/removeChannels/updateChannels` → require manage_channels
  - `addCategories/removeCategories/updateCategories` → require manage_channels
- Create: name required, creator auto-added as member with admin role
- Destroy: require manage_space, cascade delete channels+messages

**2c. Space/query, Space/queryChanges**
- Filter: name (substring), isPublic (boolean)
- Sort: name ascending (default)

**2d. Space/join**
- Accept inviteCode or spaceId (exactly one)
- Via inviteCode: resolve, check expiry/maxUses, check not banned, add member
- Via spaceId: check isPublic, check not banned, add member

**2e. SpaceInvite/get, SpaceInvite/set, SpaceInvite/changes**
- Visibility: members see own invites; manage_members see all
- Create: require manage_members; server assigns id+code
- Update: not supported (forbidden)
- Destroy: require manage_members or ownership

**2f. SpaceBan/get, SpaceBan/set, SpaceBan/changes**
- Visibility: ban permission holders see all; banned users see own
- Create: require ban permission
- Update: reason, expiresAt
- Destroy: require ban permission (lifts ban)

### Phase 3: Permission resolution engine

**3a. Permission resolution function**
- Implements spec §6.1 five-step resolution:
  1. Union permissions from all member's SpaceRoles (including @everyone at position 0)
  2. Apply channel deny overrides (role-targeted, ascending position)
  3. Apply channel allow overrides (role-targeted, ascending position)
  4. Apply channel deny overrides (member-targeted)
  5. Apply channel allow overrides (member-targeted)
- Function signature: `resolve_permission(store, space_id, chat_id, user_id, permission) -> bool`

**3b. Wire into existing handlers**
- Message/set: check "send" permission for channel chats
- Chat/set: check "manage_channels" for channel create/update in Space context

### Phase 4: Method registration

- Register all new methods in kith-jmap METHOD_ROLES (all Role::Owner)
- Add capability URI for Spaces if spec defines one

### Dependencies (internal ordering)
- Phase 1 (types+storage) → Phase 2 (handlers) → Phase 3 (permissions)
- Phase 4 can be done incrementally with each handler

### Alternative considered
Could implement a minimal "Space is just a chat group with channels" without roles/permissions. Rejected — the permission model is core to what differentiates Spaces from group chats, and shipping without it would create an API surface that needs breaking changes later.

### Files touched (estimated)
- kith-core/src/space.rs (new)
- kith-core/src/space_invite.rs (new)
- kith-core/src/space_ban.rs (new)
- kith-core/src/channel_permission.rs (new)
- kith-core/src/chat.rs (extend Chat)
- kith-core/src/lib.rs (exports)
- kith-store/src/lib.rs (migrations)
- kith-store/src/space.rs (new)
- kith-store/src/space_invite.rs (new)
- kith-store/src/space_ban.rs (new)
- kith-jmap/src/lib.rs (method registration)
- kith-chat/src/space.rs (new, handlers)
- kith-chat/src/space_invite.rs (new, handlers)
- kith-chat/src/space_ban.rs (new, handlers)
- kith-chat/src/permission.rs (new, resolution engine)
- kith-architecture.md (documentation)
notes: Broken into 9 sub-beads: KITH-1sgc (types), KITH-fu3m (schema), KITH-5gpt (Space CRUD), KITH-3lya (Category/Invite/Ban CRUD), KITH-w7rx (Space/get+changes), KITH-5hdh (Space/set), KITH-0nzf (Space/query+join), KITH-h1df (SpaceInvite handlers), KITH-6ycq (SpaceBan handlers), KITH-x15b (permission engine), KITH-ts93 (method registration). Work through sub-beads in order; this parent bead closes when all sub-beads are closed.
